tools.name: detect_feed_format
tools.description: Detect whether a feed payload is JSON, NDJSON, XML, CSV or TSV before parsing or validation.

tools.name: normalize_hotel_feed
tools.description: Parse a hotel feed and normalize common supplier/platform aliases into a canonical hotel-record shape without changing the source payload.

tools.name: validate_feed
tools.description: Validate a static hotel or catalog feed for a selected target platform.

tools.name: validate_wego_hotel_feed
tools.description: Validate a static hotel feed against Wego-oriented published requirements and data-quality checks.

tools.name: validate_google_hotel_center_list
tools.description: Validate a Google Hotel Center Hotel List static feed, including identifiers, address, country and phone/geo requirements.

tools.name: validate_trivago_hotel_data
tools.description: Validate CSV or JSON hotel inventory against trivago FastConnect's published Hotel Data requirements.

tools.name: validate_meta_catalog
tools.description: Check a hotel/travel catalog for Meta mapping and catalog readiness. This is not official Meta certification.

tools.name: validate_criteo_catalog
tools.description: Check a product/travel catalog for Criteo import readiness, content coverage, IDs, URLs and images.

tools.name: validate_hotel_master_data
tools.description: Run a platform-independent hotel master-data quality audit.

tools.name: compare_feed_readiness
tools.description: Run the same static feed through multiple platform rule packs and compare readiness scores and issue counts.

tools.name: compare_platform_requirements
tools.description: Compare published or readiness-oriented field requirements across supported hotel/catalog platforms before designing a feed mapping.

tools.name: suggest_feed_fixes
tools.description: Validate a feed for one target and turn validation issues into deterministic remediation suggestions.
